stage_1_fidelity.candidate: exact authoritative theta/C plus selected lookup K

decision: For prescribed-qbot in the strict F-AHL architecture, use the fully analytical authoritative hydraulic provider rather than a hybrid exact-retention/lookup-K provider.
rationale: Exact theta/C is sufficient to restore 12/12 strict nonlinear-path fidelity.
Keeping lookup K adds representation complexity but no robust measured speed benefit in the two preregistered timing cases.
The fully analytical qbot fallback avoids material-specific or fragile state-dependent trigger logic.
nonclaims: Other lower-boundary modes are not assigned by this result.
